hero.tagline: I build fast, observable TypeScript web products, from data flows to polished interfaces.

about.title: Who I am, in one paragraph
about.manifesto: Five years building software for hospitality, finance, energy, and data teams, mostly where back ends and interfaces meet. I write strict TypeScript, prefer clear contracts over defensive comments, and design systems that stay maintainable as they grow.

duration.yearsMonths: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} and {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}

hotelgest-2025.summary: Full-stack development on hotelgest's PMS, a hotel management platform used by independent hotels.
highlights: Implemented product features on the front end with React.
Built APIs and business logic with TypeScript and NestJS.
Worked with typed, clean, reviewed code to keep the codebase maintainable.

andbank-2024.summary: Developed banking applications in a regulated environment, mainly focused on front-end and mobile apps.
highlights: Fixed and implemented features in web applications with React.
Developed and maintained mobile applications with Xamarin and .NET.
Worked under banking-sector review, change-control, and quality processes.

eosol-software-manager-2023.summary: Led the data science team building scalable software for big-data visualization and querying.
highlights: Designed an architecture based on Parquet files in S3, AWS Glue, and AWS Athena to query data directly on the data lake.
Used PostgreSQL for metadata and built interfaces with AngularJS and React for internal resource administration.
Coordinated the team technically, defined good practices, and kept a focus on maintainable, typed, reviewed code.

eosol-software-developer-2022.summary: Built the web interface that let the civil engineering team use the earthworks optimization tool.
highlights: Developed the front end with Flask to configure runs and inspect optimization results.
Modeled and persisted data with MongoDB for projects, configurations, and results.
Turned a technical tool into an application usable by teams without software specialization.

eosol-data-engineer-2021.summary: Developed optimization tools and data pipelines for civil engineering and energy operations teams.
highlights: Built a Python CLI tool to minimize earthworks when placing piles for solar parks.
Used threads, processes, and Google OR-Tools to solve manufacturer and terrain constraints with optimization criteria.
Designed Airflow ETLs for extracting, processing, and loading meteorological data.

upna-research-2020.summary: Research on big-data processing infrastructure and storage migration.
highlights: Built a Hortonworks-based pipeline with Sqoop, Hive, and Kafka.
Restructured a NoSQL database and migrated it to MySQL.
Wrote a backend in Express.js to expose the new schema.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.hint: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · personal selection

apidex.name: apidex
apidex.summary: Local-first OpenAPI playground. Upload a JSON or YAML specification and get a clean, navigable view of every operation; share specifications through S3 + DynamoDB, optionally protected by a password.
highlights: Parses and validates OpenAPI specs (JSON or YAML) entirely in the browser.
Type-safe sharing API built with tRPC and Zod.
Shared specs persisted in S3 + DynamoDB, optionally password-protected.
Clean, navigable view of every operation in a specification.

andllar.name: andllar
andllar.summary: Real-estate marketplace for Andorra. Listings, agency promotions, and map-based search with full multilingual support across English, Spanish, Catalan, and French.
highlights: Map-based property search powered by Mapbox.
Fully multilingual across English, Spanish, Catalan and French.
Data layer on Prisma + Supabase with image storage on S3.
Listings and agency promotions with React Query data fetching.

sowify-admin.name: Internal admin suite
sowify-admin.summary: Custom internal admin and ERP suite. Invoicing with PDF generation and email delivery, expense tracking, CRM (leads, partners, investors), contacts, role-based access, and dashboards on a type-safe tRPC + Prisma stack.
highlights: Invoicing with server-side PDF generation and email delivery.
CRM for leads, partners and investors, plus contacts and expense tracking.
Role-based access control with better-auth.
End-to-end type safety on a tRPC + Prisma + MongoDB stack.

sowify-landing.name: Sowify Global Solutions
sowify-landing.summary: Multilingual corporate landing page for Sowify. It presents the agrotech value proposition, Luca, services, and legal content through localized routes, Next.js metadata-driven SEO copy, polished animations, and visual assets served from Luca's data domain.
highlights: Localized routes and SEO copy driven by Next.js metadata.
Polished, purposeful motion with Framer Motion and Radix UI.
Presents the agrotech value proposition and the Luca product.
Visual assets served from Luca's data domain.

portfolio.name: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: The very site you are reading, built entirely through spec-driven development. Each feature started as a written spec defining outcomes, contracts, and acceptance checks before any code, on a type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing and purposeful motion.
highlights: Built spec-first: every feature began as a written spec before any code.
Type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing.
Interactive terminal and ⌘K command palette for navigation.
Purposeful motion that never blocks content or shifts layout.
